criterion_descriptions: Navigate to and use the CVE.org CNA record for CVE-2021-44228 (e.g., via the provided starting URL). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on the CNA record on CVE.org OR if CVE.org is inaccessible (downtime, blocking, captcha, loading errors) and the agent explicitly reports the blocker and what was attempted (e.g., retry/refresh). Partial credit if the agent appears to use CVE.org but mixes in third-party data for requested CNA-only fields when CVE.org content is available.

Provide all requested metadata fields from the CVE.org CNA record: (1) status, (2) publication date, (3) CNA, (4) vendor, and (5) product. Full credit if all five are present and match the CNA record. If CVE.org is inaccessible, award full credit if the agent clearly states it cannot retrieve these fields due to the blocker identified in criterion 1 (do not penalize for missing fields caused by that blocker). Partial credit if only some of the five fields are visible/retrievable from CVE.org and the agent reports those while explicitly noting which fields were not displayed/available in the CNA record view.

Extract and reproduce verbatim the affected-version statement from the CNA record's Description for CVE-2021-44228, preserving boundaries and any excluded releases exactly as displayed. Full credit if the statement is quoted exactly. If the Description is not accessible due to CVE.org unavailability/blocking, award full credit if the agent explicitly reports it cannot retrieve the affected-version statement from the CNA Description because of that blocker (and does not substitute third-party ranges). Partial credit if there are minor transcription errors that do not alter boundaries/exclusions, or if the agent quotes the Description but omits a small portion of the affected-version statement despite it being visible.

Provide the first reference URL shown in the CVE.org CNA record’s References section (as displayed on CVE.org). Full credit if the URL matches the first listed reference. If the References section is not accessible/displayed due to CVE.org unavailability or page rendering issues, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve the first reference URL because of that blocker and does not follow external links. Partial credit if a valid reference URL from the CNA record is provided but it is not the first one listed.

Adhere to task constraints by (a) not following or downloading content from external reference links, (b) using only the CNA record and its Description for the affected-version statement (or explicitly stating it is unavailable if CVE.org is blocked), (c) preserving version boundaries/exclusions exactly as displayed when quoting, and (d) stopping once all requested metadata, the exact affected-version statement, and the first CNA reference URL are recorded (or once unavailability has been clearly reported). Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if the agent adds minor extra, non-conflicting information beyond the stopping condition. No credit if the agent follows external links for content, mixes in third-party advisory versioning when CNA data is available, or materially violates the stopping condition.
